column1: # Game profile of DRAGON QUEST BUILDERS 2 (Switch, base game v0 + update 1.7.3d = v393216): played on the Mac through character creation and the ship prologue, see README.md
# Koei Tecmo's (Omega Force) KTGL engine on NVN, SDK 5.4.0; modules main + subsdk0 (GLSLC, NVN's runtime shader compiler) + subsdk1 (the movie library, NintendoSDK_movie) + sdk

# RomFS: the LINKDATA archive LINKDATA.IDX (index of 32-byte entries) + LINKDATA.BIN (1.1 GB, 59,193 entries), sound banks in binary/sound, two MP4 movies in movie/. Compressed entries are Koei Tecmo's chunked zlib; the shaders are GLSLC outputs in those entries
# The NPDM declares no system resource (META +0x14 = 0): the game uses SetHeapSize. The guessed 4 GB partition held through the play test: 2.5 GB footprint on the ship

# KTGL compiles 6 built-in GLSL shaders at boot with the game's own GLSLC (subsdk0; sources in main): the NSP script captures them once on the Mac (hle_glslc.c), as for any game whose main holds GLSL sources and imports glslcCompile
